requirement_text: Give the Data Principal a notice accompanying or preceding every request for consent
Notice must describe the personal data and the purpose for which it is proposed to be processed
Notice must inform of the manner to exercise rights and to make a complaint to the Board
Consent must be free specific informed unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action
Provide the right to withdraw consent with ease comparable to giving it
Be able to demonstrate that notice was given and consent obtained where questioned in a proceeding
Process personal data only in accordance with the Act and for a lawful purpose
Process only on the basis of consent or certain legitimate uses
Lawful purpose means any purpose not expressly forbidden by law
Protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach
Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure observance of the Act
Protect personal data in possession or control including where processed by a Data Processor
Ensure completeness accuracy and consistency of personal data used for decisions or disclosure
Publish the business contact information of the Data Protection Officer or a responsible person
Establish an effective mechanism to redress grievances of Data Principals
Give intimation of a personal data breach to the Board and each affected Data Principal in the prescribed form and manner
Intimate each affected Data Principal of the personal data breach
Intimate the Data Protection Board of India of the personal data breach
Provide breach intimation in such form and manner as may be prescribed
Establish an effective grievance redressal mechanism for Data Principals
Respond to grievances within such period as may be prescribed
Maintain the grievance redressal mechanism as required
Retain personal data only while necessary for the specified purpose or for legal compliance
Erase personal data upon withdrawal of consent or when the specified purpose is no longer served
Cause the Data Processor to erase personal data made available to it for processing
Provide a summary of personal data being processed and the processing activities on request
Provide the identities of other Data Fiduciaries and Processors with whom personal data has been shared
Correct complete or update personal data upon a request from the Data Principal
Erase personal data upon request unless retention is necessary for a specified purpose or legal compliance
Provide readily available means of grievance redressal to the Data Principal
Data Principal shall exhaust grievance redressal under the Act before approaching the Board
Enable the Data Principal to nominate another individual to exercise rights on death or incapacity
Data Principal shall comply with applicable laws and not impersonate another person when providing data
Data Principal shall not register a false or frivolous grievance and shall furnish only authentic information
Central Government may notify a Data Fiduciary or class as a Significant Data Fiduciary
Significant Data Fiduciary shall undertake periodic Data Protection Impact Assessment
Significant Data Fiduciary shall undertake periodic audit and other prescribed measures
Significant Data Fiduciary shall appoint a Data Protection Officer based in India
Data Protection Impact Assessment shall describe rights of Data Principals and manage processing risk
Significant Data Fiduciary shall appoint an independent data auditor to evaluate compliance
Engage a Data Processor to process personal data only under a valid contract
Data Fiduciary remains responsible for compliance for processing undertaken by a Data Processor
Involve a Data Processor for offering goods or services to Data Principals only under a valid contract
Transfer personal data outside India subject to any restriction notified by the Central Government
Any law providing a higher degree of protection on transfer outside India continues to apply
Undertake periodic Data Protection Impact Assessment as a Significant Data Fiduciary
The Data Protection Board of India is established by the Central Government by notification
Data Protection Officer appointed by the Significant Data Fiduciary represents it and is the grievance point of contact
Obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian before processing a child's personal data
Shall not undertake tracking behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children
Shall not undertake processing likely to cause any detrimental effect on the well-being of a child
Obtain verifiable consent of the lawful guardian of a person with disability in the prescribed manner
